metadata.title: World Digest — November 22, 2026
metadata.summary: The AI trade unraveled as Nvidia plunged 14% and markets slid, even as the administration approved roughly 900,000 AI chips for China.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Democrats Clinch Their Largest House Majority This Century

Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated 11-term Republican Rep. Virginia Foxx after a recount, helping Democrats secure 258 House seats, their biggest majority in decades. CBS News

COP31 Climate Talks Collapse Over Fossil Fuels

Global climate negotiations in Turkey ended without a deal as countries clashed over phasing out fossil fuels, marking a major setback for international climate action. The New York Times The Guardian

U.S. Approves Nearly 900,000 AI Chips for China

The Trump administration greenlit shipments of roughly 900,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, contradicting earlier crackdown rhetoric and drawing scrutiny from policymakers. Yahoo

Measles Death in Virginia Signals Public Health Crisis

A Virginia child under five died from measles, the state's first such death in 2026, as cases surge amid falling vaccination rates and lost elimination status. 9NEWS Financial Times

Voyager 1 Reaches One Light-Day From Earth

NASA's Voyager 1, launched 49 years ago, crossed the milestone of being one light-day away, though engineers are managing a data issue. The Times of India

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Affairs

Pentagon memos reportedly restrict U.S.-Canada military social ties, urging Ottawa to boost defense spending Axios. COP31 climate talks collapsed over fossil fuel disputes The Guardian. The Red Cross warned it may soon be too late to regulate autonomous weapons after UN talks stalled The Guardian. Ukrainian civilians brace for winter amid intensified Russian strikes on energy infrastructure AP News.

Middle East

Israeli coalition talks between Netanyahu and Eisenkot ended without a deal CNA Al Jazeera. Settler attacks on Palestinian villages drew condemnation, with Eisenkot calling it “Jewish terrorism” The Guardian. Iran escalated Gulf attacks, striking an industrial facility in Bahrain Al Jazeera and unveiling a new underground “missile city” Al Jazeera.

United States

Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warned Americans of “bumps in the road” amid tech outages The Hill. President Trump ordered federal contractors to clear congressional responses with the White House 9NEWS. Hakeem Jeffries pledged a congressional stock-trading ban early next term The Hill.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Rattled by AI Rout; Chips to China Approved

US stocks slid as the AI trade unraveled, with Goldman Sachs warning of up to $80.6B in further selling Bloomberg.com. Nvidia's earnings failed to calm jitters amid the chip export controversy Forbes. China’s AI stocks lost $1.7T Bloomberg.com. Copper plunged to April lows on AI gloom Business Insider. Trump blamed a $6T slide on Democrats The Hill. Separately, the administration approved shipping ~900,000 AI chips to China Yahoo. Anthropic’s IPO raised hopes for charity windfalls AP News. Bessent sought Nvidia answers CBS News.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Nintendo Switch 2 Black Friday Deals Go Live

Retailers are offering the Switch 2 console at a $50 discount for Black Friday, with bundles including Mario Kart World priced the same as the console alone The Verge. Deals span consoles, games, and accessories The Verge.

Apple Prepping Spring 2027 Product Launches

Apple reportedly plans February or March releases for new hardware, with a production milestone suggesting the iPhone 18 could launch in March MacRumors. Reports also point to the iPhone 18e and MacBook Neo 2 arriving sooner than expected MacRumors.

NVIDIA Driver SSD Bug Persists

NVIDIA's 621.35 hotfix driver still causes excessive SSD writes, with one user reporting 36GB written while idle overnight Wccftech. The bug reportedly can write up to 30GB per hour Wccftech.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

‘Sunrise on the Reaping’ reignited the Hunger Games franchise with a $120 million debut, the year’s biggest opening Variety. Miley Cyrus married Maxx Morando in a California ceremony, sharing first official photos BBC. Mahershala Ali revealed that two Oscars “don’t matter” for casting, noting a lack of roles The Hollywood Reporter. Paolo Bulgari, who built the global luxury jewelry brand, died at 89 NPR. David Fincher defended AI use in his new film IndieWire.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Recent pricings: No price set for GM Yahoo Finance, Guerrilla RF Yahoo Finance, Zoar Yahoo Finance, Anthropic Yahoo Finance, F & M Bank Yahoo Finance, or Cizzle Brands Yahoo Finance. Upcoming listings: ProShares Ultra/UltraShort Anthropic (ANTU, ANTY) and Clywedog Therapeutics (Nasdaq, 11-23) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance; Quantum Space (NYSE, 11-24) Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

S&P 500 fell 3.70% to 6,910.39; Nasdaq dropped 5.28% to 22,617.73 Yahoo Finance. Dow lost 1.93%, Russell 2000 slid 2.76%. VIX spiked 26.20% to 35.89 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Technology led losses, down 7.27% Yahoo Finance. Consumer Staples gained 0.67%, the only advancer. Industrials (-3.09%) and Consumer Discretionary (-2.95%) also lagged.

Major Stocks

Nvidia plunged 14.01% to $125.53; Broadcom fell 12.19% Yahoo Finance. Tesla dropped 7.64%, Meta 5.93%. Apple (-1.90%) and Microsoft (-2.77%) declined. Berkshire slipped just 0.36%.

Notable Movers

Gap surged 11.4% Yahoo Finance; Global Payments rose 9.9% Yahoo Finance. IREN fell 18.0% Yahoo Finance, Applied Digital -17.8% Yahoo Finance. Most active: Nvidia, Anthropic (-8.5%) Yahoo Finance, Intel (-8.0%) Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield fell 2.77% to 4.91% Yahoo Finance. Gold gained 2.88% to $3,616.80; Bitcoin rose 2.20%. WTI crude dipped 0.89% to $83.23.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
24–48 Hours

  • AI selloff aftershocks: Watch for continued volatility as Goldman flags further selling pressure; Nvidia guidance and Bessent's response may stabilize or extend losses.
  • Israeli coalition talks: Netanyahu–Eisenkot breakdown could trigger new elections or unilateral moves affecting regional stability.

Next Week

  • Policy whiplash: The AI chip approval to China faces likely congressional scrutiny; watch for executive clarifications.
  • UN autonomous weapons talks may resume after Red Cross warnings.

Next Month

  • COP31 fallout: Expect blame-shifting and possible alternative climate frameworks from major emitters.
  • Measles response: Virginia's death may accelerate federal vaccination pushes or state mandates.
